detail.summary: 0 blocking, 0 advisory, 5 repair target finding(s) recorded.

repairTargets.title: 1. q1 includes answer and rationale
repairTargets.rationale: Issue #383 の Goal は、AI review/gate の retry 上限到達時に semantic finding を自動 defer し、acceptance-review で完成物と証拠から再評価することでよいですか。
repairTargets.evidence: Question includes “推奨: Yes” and rationale text instead of only the question text.

repairTargets.title: 2. q2 includes instruction, answer, and rationale
repairTargets.rationale: mechanical blocker は defer 対象外として停止を維持し、semantic insufficiency だけを acceptance-review に送る境界でよいですか。mechanical blocker とは schema invalid、required artifact missing、test/command failure、tooling failure、flow state corruption、no-progress guard のように存在や成功条件が満たされない失敗です。
repairTargets.evidence: Question includes “must:”, “推奨: Yes”, and rationale text.

repairTargets.title: 3. q3 includes instruction, answer, and rationale
repairTargets.rationale: flow-findings.json は finding 詳細を複製せず、findingId、sourceStep、sourceArtifact、sourceFindingId、retryExhausted、attempts、round などの参照情報を保存する契約でよいですか。
repairTargets.evidence: Question includes “must:”, “推奨: Yes”, and rationale text.

repairTargets.title: 4. q4 includes instruction, answer, and rationale
repairTargets.rationale: acceptance-review の final classification は fixed、not_needed、false_positive、pre_existing、still_open、blocking を最低限含め、verdict が pass でない場合は nextAction と allowlist 済み targetStep を artifact に保存する条件でよいですか。
repairTargets.evidence: Question includes “must:”, “推奨: Yes”, and rationale text.

repairTargets.title: 5. q5 includes instruction, answer, and rationale
repairTargets.rationale: acceptance round 2 回目でも verdict が pass でない場合は自動 loop を止め、仕様から修正、実装/検証から修正、リスク受け入れ、中止の選択肢を出す扱いでよいですか。mechanical blocker がある場合はリスク受け入れを許可しませんか。
repairTargets.evidence: Question includes “must:”, “推奨: Yes”, and rationale text.
